metadata.case_name: LIMBU MAN BAHADUR v. TSANG CHAN FAI AND ANOTHER

injuries.description: pre-existing bilateral L5/S1 facet joint lesions
source: The joint opinion was that the plaintiff had pre-existing bilateral L5/S1 facet joint lesions at the time of the captioned accident.
injuries.icd_description: Other specified injuries to the abdomen, lower back, lumbar spine or pelvis

source: the plaintiff sustained low back contusion injury during the accident, resulting in essentially soft tissue injuries with or without minor left L5/S1 facet joint fracture (on top of the pre-existing lesion).
injuries.icd_description: Contusion of lower back or pelvis

injuries.description: chronic intra-articular comminuted fracture left side L5/S1 facet joint
source: CT scan lumbar spine taken on 28 May 2001 showed chronic intra-articular comminuted fracture left side L5/S1 facet joint.

manifestations.description: large patch of bruise over his left gluteal region
tenderness over lower lumbar spine and sacrum, para-spinal muscles as well as left upper buttock
unable to fully squat down because of back pain
could walk but with difficulty using one stick on his discharge on 6 May 2001
complained of increased back pain on walking on tiptoes and heels
persistent low back pain; some residual low back pain from time to time would be expected to be permanent
There was no neurological deficit as a result.

treatments_received: rigid thoraco-lumbar orthosis (to be worn for 6 weeks or more to protect his back)
